Name: Pack to splices
From terminal: XT60 robot half + / XT60 robot half -
Carries: 14.8 V nominal (12.0-16.8 V), up to 15 A
Connectors: XT60 robot half to the WAGO pack node and star ground
Notes: The XT60 is the service disconnect: unplug it before touching the power board.

Name: Motor rail
From terminal: TB2-1 MOT+ (after K1, INA260 #1) / TB2-2 MOT-
Carries: 14.8 V switched by K1, 3 A typical, 10 A peak (both motors)
Connectors: TB2 on the power board to the driver's VM/GND screws
Notes: Dead whenever the e-stop is pressed or the RC link drops: K1's coil loop opens in hardware.

Name: Left motor
Connectors: Driver M1 screws to the motor leads (Micro-Fit 2-pin at the module)
Notes: Leave a 40 mm loop at the module: it moves 10 mm up and 5 mm down.

Name: Right motor
Connectors: Driver M2 screws to the motor leads (Micro-Fit 2-pin at the module)
Notes: Leave a 40 mm loop at the module.

Name: Compute feed, lower
Connectors: TB3 to deck power plug pins 1-2

Name: Compute feed, upper
Carries: 14.8 V into INA260 #2, D2, C1 and Buck A
Connectors: Deck power plug pins 1-2 to the compute block

Name: Pi 5 power
Connectors: Buck A output to a USB-C plug
Notes: The Pi cannot negotiate 5 A over a plain pigtail, so it limits USB to 600 mA; add usb_max_current_enable=1 if needed.

Name: Sensor feed, lower
Connectors: TB3 to deck power plug pins 3-4

Name: Sensor feed, upper
Carries: 14.8 V into INA260 #3 and Buck B
Connectors: Deck power plug pins 3-4 to the sensor block

Name: OAK-D power
Carries: 5 V, 0.9 A typical, 3 A worst case
Connectors: Buck B output to the Y-adapter's power port
Notes: Keeps up to 15 W off the Pi's USB.

Name: LiDAR power
Connectors: Buck B output to the LiDAR splice

Name: Controller power
Carries: 5 V, 0.6 A: ESP32, encoders, cliff sensors (3.3 V from the DevKit), level shifter
Connectors: JST-XH 2-pin at the carrier

Name: RC relay power
Connectors: JST-XH 2-pin
Notes: Also powers the receiver through the servo lead.

Name: Power board feed
Carries: 14.8 V into F1 (15 A) and the power-board ground
Connectors: WAGO to TB1

Name: Charge contact +
Carries: 16.8 V CC/CV from the dock, 3 A
Connectors: M4 ring lug on the contact to the F2 holder lead

Name: Charge contact -
Connectors: M4 ring lug to the star ground

Name: Charge to pack
Carries: 16.8 V, 3 A into the pack node ahead of F1
Connectors: D1 OUT to the WAGO pack node
Notes: The robot keeps running on dock power while it charges.

Name: E-stop loop, lower
From terminal: TB4-1 K1 coil feed / TB4-2 K1 coil return
To terminal: Pin 5 loop out / Pin 6 loop return
Connectors: TB4 to deck power plug pins 5-6

Name: E-stop loop, upper
From terminal: Pin 5 loop out / Pin 6 loop return
Connectors: Deck power plug pins 5-6 to the e-stop block

Name: E-stop loop to K2
From terminal: NC1 out to K2 / Loop return from K2
Connectors: E-stop block to K2's screw terminals
Notes: Press the e-stop, switch the transmitter off or lose the radio link: the loop opens and K1 drops the motor rail.

Name: OAK-D to Y-adapter
Carries: USB 3.2 Gen 1, 5 Gbit/s: video, depth, IMU
Connectors: USB-C both ends

Name: Y-adapter to Pi
Carries: USB 3.2 Gen 1 to the Pi's blue port
Connectors: USB-C to USB-A

Name: LiDAR lead
Carries: TX 3.3 V UART 230400 8N1, PWM (unused), GND, 5 V
Connectors: ZH1.5T-4P at the LiDAR, splice at J2
Pins: Pin 1 TX, pin 2 PWM (open), pin 3 GND, pin 4 5 V
Notes: Down the riser bore and the 20 mm deck hole.

Name: LiDAR scan data
Carries: UART 230400, LiDAR to Pi only (/scan at 10 Hz)
Connectors: Splice to the HAT's JST-XH
Pins: LiDAR TX to Pi pin 29 (GPIO5, UART2 RX); GND to pin 30. dtoverlay=uart2-pi5

Name: micro-ROS link
Carries: UART 921600, full duplex: /cmd_vel down at 50 Hz, odometry and IMU up at 100 Hz
Connectors: JST-XH 3-pin both ends
Pins: Pi pin 8 (GPIO14 TX) to ESP32 GPIO18; Pi pin 10 (GPIO15 RX) to GPIO17; pin 6 GND. dtoverlay=uart0-pi5
Notes: The 300 ms command watchdog lives on the ESP32 end.

Name: Deck signal cable
Carries: Everything the ESP32 needs from the lower deck
Connectors: Micro-Fit 24 at the deck plug, 2 x 12 IDC at the carrier
Pins: Encoders 4, driver 6, I2C 2, XSHUT 3, bumper 2, 5 V, 3V3, GND x 2, 3 spare
Notes: Unplug at the deck plug to lift the top deck.

Name: Motor commands
To terminal: PWM1 INA1 INB1 PWM2 INA2 INB2 GND
Carries: PWM 20 kHz plus INA/INB per channel, 3.3 V logic
Connectors: Deck plug branch to the driver's control header
Pins: GPIO4 PWM1, GPIO5 INA1, GPIO6 INB1, GPIO7 PWM2, GPIO15 INA2, GPIO16 INB2, GND

Name: Left encoder
Connectors: Micro-Fit 4-pin at the module, deck plug branch
Pins: GND, 5 V, A to GPIO10 and B to GPIO11 through the 74LVC244
Notes: Leave a 40 mm loop at the module.

Name: Right encoder
Connectors: Micro-Fit 4-pin at the module, deck plug branch
Pins: GND, 5 V, A to GPIO12 and B to GPIO13 through the 74LVC244

Name: Motor current sense
Connectors: Deck plug branch to JST-XH 4

Name: Cliff sensor FL
Connectors: Deck plug branch to the STEMMA QT (JST-SH 4) plus the XSHUT header pin

Name: Cliff sensor FR
Connectors: Deck plug branch to the STEMMA QT (JST-SH 4) plus the XSHUT header pin

Name: Cliff sensor RL
Connectors: Deck plug branch to the STEMMA QT (JST-SH 4) plus the XSHUT header pin

Name: Cliff sensor RR
Connectors: Deck plug branch to the STEMMA QT (JST-SH 4)
Pins: 3V3, GND, SDA, SCL. No XSHUT: the firmware readdresses this sensor first
Notes: Rev B: its XSHUT line (GPIO40) went to K2's status signal.

Name: Bumper switch L
Carries: Contact closure, pull-up on the ESP32
Connectors: Deck plug branch to the switch tabs

Name: Bumper switch R
Carries: Contact closure, pull-up on the ESP32
Connectors: Deck plug branch to the switch tabs

Name: E-stop echo
Connectors: NC2 block to JST-XH 2
Notes: Reporting only. Stopping never depends on this wire.

Name: Status light
Connectors: JST-XH to the indicator's tabs

Name: Recording light
Connectors: JST-XH to the indicator's tabs
Pins: Pi pin 16 (GPIO23) drives the transistor; 5 V from pin 4
Notes: Driven by the Pi because the Pi knows when a stream is live.

Name: Microphone array
Carries: USB audio class, 16 kHz, 4 mics + echo reference
Connectors: micro-USB to USB-A

Name: Speaker
Connectors: USB-A

Name: RC receiver to K2
Carries: RC PWM, 5 V and ground to the receiver
Connectors: Servo plug both ends

Name: K2 status
To terminal: K2 OUT to GPIO40 via the 74LVC244
Carries: OUT (relay on). K2's outputs swing to 5 V through 220 ohm
Connectors: JST-XH 3
Pins: OUT to GPIO40 through a spare 74LVC244 channel; GOOD is a spare conductor, not connected at the carrier; GND
Notes: Never straight to an ESP32 pin: K2's outputs are 5 V, and GPIO47/48 run at 1.8 V on the N32R16V.

Name: Top-deck I2C
Connectors: JST-XH 4 both ends

Name: I2C to compute block
Connectors: JST-XH 4 both ends
